title: 第6074章 进入诸天神狱第6073章 星河深处无限之海
lines: “果然恐怖！”
叶寒心中一震。
按照他所知晓的，这无限之海，实则是禁忌之地。
广袤无垠的神秘海域中，生存着可能比整个第七层诸天的众生万灵数量还多的生命体。
各种可怕的异兽，怪胎，都隐藏在这无限之海中。
认真而言，整个第七层诸天，黄金神国，以及如今的造化神国，万古神国这些，也只能算是占据了这第七层诸天的一半。
而另一半，实则就是这无限之海。
不过，无限之海内部生存的生灵，虽然恐怖至极，数量无比之多，但对于黄金之主这尊绝世无敌的强者，还是非常忌惮，无比敬畏的。
在昔年，便和黄金神国签订了誓约。
黄金神国在这无限之海深处建立一座诸天神狱，未来，但凡黄金神国的高手，进入无限之海，只要身上带着特殊的令牌，便要让路。
这誓约一签订，几乎可以说，让诸天神狱变成了这第七层诸天之中，仅次于帝州皇宫的重地。
任何生灵，一旦被镇压到诸天神狱中，几乎不可能逃出生天。
就算可以从诸天神狱中活着出来，也不可能横渡无限之海，不可能无视这无限之海中的无数可怕生灵而逃离。
可能半途之中，都会被撕碎，被吞掉，连一滴血都不可能剩下。
叶寒顷刻间，就祭出了黄金帝剑。
神圣的气息缠绕在剑体之上，亦加持在他的本体之中。
顿时……
这至高无上的帝王气机弥漫，从时空中渗透下去，那沸腾的海域，在悄然间陷入了平静之中。
海面之下，那些隐藏起来的可怕目光与神念，都在无声无息间收回。
“居然，有着大量的无界者，甚至混沌主宰。”
叶寒心跳。
刚才那一瞬间，他甚至隐约察觉到了一道起源始祖的气息。
这无限之海内部，简直堪称是另一个神国。
只不过，这是异兽的神国。
“无限之海中，莫非真有一个神国！”
“这座无垠的海域，存在着一个神秘而可怕的主人，掌控者吧？”
叶寒不禁涌现出无数个念头。
倒是莫名诞生出一些想法。
叶寒知晓，这无限之海中孕育出来的生灵，似乎并不能够离开无限之海。
整座广袤无垠的无限之海，对于这些生灵，或者说大部分是异兽而言，其实上乃是一座巨大的牢笼而已，被永生永世困在其中。
然而，刚刚那一刹，他几乎可以确定，无限之海里面所隐藏的绝世高手……
论数量，恐怕比黄金神国只多不少。
这代表着什么？
代表这是一座究极大宝藏。
要知道，正常而言，人族，包括诸天大部分种族修行，顶多能够炼化其他生灵的体质本源。
连血脉本源，其实上都不敢轻易炼化，轻易掠夺。
否则，不同的血脉在体内冲击，无法融合，将会产生反噬，直接走火入魔而死。
但是这无限之海里面，大部分都是异兽。
这些异兽，都是补品。
在本质上，和鸡鸭鹅，是没有区别的。
血和肉，都是补品。
content_en:
"It's really scary!"
Ye Han was shocked.
According to what he knew, this infinite sea was actually a forbidden place.
In the vast and mysterious sea, there may be more life forms than the number of sentient beings in the entire seventh heaven.
All kinds of terrifying beasts and monsters are hidden in this infinite sea.
Seriously speaking, the entire seventh-level heavens, the Golden Divine Kingdom, as well as the current Creation Divine Kingdom, and the Eternal Divine Kingdom, can only be regarded as occupying half of the seventh-level heavens.
The other half is actually this infinite sea.
However, although the creatures living inside the Infinite Sea are extremely terrifying and extremely numerous, they are still very fearful and in awe of the Lord of Gold, an invincible and powerful man.
In the past year, he signed an oath with the Golden Kingdom.
The Golden Kingdom has established a prison of gods in the depths of the Infinite Sea. In the future, any master from the Golden Kingdom who enters the Infinite Sea must give way as long as they carry a special token.
Once this oath was signed, it could almost be said that the All Heavens Divine Prison became the most important place in the seventh heaven, second only to the Imperial Palace.
Once any living creature is suppressed in the prison of the gods, it is almost impossible to escape.
Even if you can escape from the prison of the gods alive, you can't cross the infinite sea, and you can't escape without ignoring the countless terrifying creatures in the infinite sea.
Maybe they will be torn into pieces and swallowed halfway, and not even a drop of blood will be left.
Ye Han instantly used the Golden Emperor Sword.
The sacred aura wrapped around the sword body and blessed his body.
Suddenly...
This supreme imperial energy filled the air, seeping down from time and space, and the boiling sea area quietly fell into calm.
Under the sea, those hidden terrifying gazes and thoughts were withdrawn silently.
"Surprisingly, there are a large number of Unbounded Ones, even Chaos Lords."
Ye Han's heart beat.
At that moment, he even vaguely sensed the aura of the origin ancestor.
The interior of this infinite sea is simply another divine kingdom.
However, this is the divine kingdom of strange beasts.
"Is there really a kingdom of God in the infinite sea?"
"In this boundless sea, there is a mysterious and terrifying master, the controller, right?"
Ye Han couldn't help but have countless thoughts.
But some ideas came out of nowhere.
Ye Han knew that the creatures born in this infinite sea seemed unable to leave the infinite sea.
For these creatures, or most of the alien beasts, the entire vast infinite sea is actually just a huge cage, trapped in it for eternity.
However, at that moment, he was almost certain that the peerless master hidden in the infinite sea...
In terms of quantity, I'm afraid it's only a lot more than the Golden Kingdom.
What does this mean?
It means this is an ultimate treasure.
You must know that normally, the human race, including most races in the world, can at most refine the physical origin of other living beings.
Even the origin of bloodline actually dare not be easily refined or plundered.
Otherwise, different blood vessels will collide in the body and fail to fuse, which will cause backlash and lead to death.
But in this infinite sea, most of them are strange beasts.
These strange beasts are all supplements.
In essence, there is no difference between chickens, ducks and geese.
Blood and flesh are both supplements.
